predicates.existing: Source names the low source/destination registers and unconditional ADDR2 bits; no DMA API address is joined to an executed transfer.
predicates.missing: Mapped bus address, exact programmed source/destination and both ADDR2 values from the same successful transfer.

predicates.existing: Static HIF aperture and polling protocol; runtime HIF thread and BTIF counters are different observations.
predicates.missing: HIF endpoint bus translation with ordered EN/INT_FLAG observations for that same transfer.

predicates.existing: Static stop/timeout paths lack a guaranteed positive idle witness; no observed before-unmap ordering.
predicates.missing: Positive channel-idle witness preceding unmap/release, attributable to the same transfer.

predicates.existing: WMT fallback reports common firmware load success; no completed WLAN firmware-stop event or paired shutdown.
predicates.missing: A named WLAN firmware-stop completion predicate and cycle join, not interface-down or module bookkeeping.

predicates.existing: Source and retained static control flow put clock-disable before reset; passive mainline counters are zero.
predicates.missing: Executed ordered protection/isolation/clock/reset/power-request and ACK effects for the same shutdown, with shared-client ownership.

contradictions: Normal queued and late-registration source paths do not have uniform common-resource acquisition; source bookkeeping cannot prove an enduring lease.
Clock/reset ordering differs between vendor/static CONN evidence and the older upstream path; neither is a runtime equivalence proof.
negative_results: No private text/log candidate matched the bounded inventory.
No inspected repository record joins WLAN load, DMA programming, idle, firmware stop and CONSYS OFF to one successful cycle.
The current Gemian standard kprobe/function-tracing path is absent in the accepted capability record.
transferable: Observed Gemian WLAN/driver/HIF presence and common WMT fallback behavior remain their original bounded facts.
Static register/control-flow attribution and fixture results retain their original evidence class.
The passive mainline BOUND generation with zero effects remains a passive-binding result.
limitations: No runtime lifecycle predicate is proved or partially promoted by source sequencing.
Successful common WMT patch loading is not proof of a WLAN image load/shutdown cycle.
BTIF DMA counters are not HIF AP-DMA completion witnesses.
A future normal-cycle observation alone cannot prove failed-operation retention or safe teardown.
No firmware redistribution, driver reuse, implementation, candidate or hardware-support admission follows.
next_discriminator: Freeze and independently review one distinct non-replayed observation protocol capable of joining the five predicates to one successful WLAN load/shutdown cycle; define acquisition effects, shared ownership, finite budget and recovery before use. This audit selects no mechanism and does not reopen the owner-closed retained-instruction line.
